name: remove_bg
description: Remove video or image background (RVM, CPU): a video gives a ProRes 4444 .mov with alpha + VP9 WebM preview, an image a PNG with alpha. Video is LONG-RUNNING, about 0.1 s per megapixel per frame: batch clips with inputs, run in the background with progress (per-frame JSON on stderr). Pass max-height to matte at the size the clip is shown; downsample 1.0 for sharper video edges (slower).

output.description: { nobg_src: .mov for render, nobg_preview_src: WebM preview }; an image: { out: PNG, width, height }

params.name: out
params.description: Output path, with input only. Default {stem}_nobg.mov, an image {stem}-cutout.png

params.name: downsample
params.description: Video inference resolution ratio, relative to the frame RVM is given. 1.0 = full resolution (about 4x slower, sharper hair).

params.name: max-height
params.description: Scales the cutout down so its display height is at most this many pixels (a positive even number), never up. Width follows the aspect ratio. Omit to keep the source size.
